Text: Almighty and merciful God, You have given us the gift of Your loving grace. Only this gift makes Your faithful worthy to serve You with praise. [t] Be present with us, we pray, [*] as each quickened step brings us toward Your promises. We run to You, freed from the hindrances of sin
